en.apiHint: Uses the standalone REST API. Upgrading from 0.1.0? Save this mode to keep API billing.
en.baseHint: An inherited endpoint may come from configuration or ZAI_SEARCH_BASE_URL.
en.billingHint: Search never switches to paid API automatically.
en.codingHint: Requires an eligible subscription. Search uses plan quota even without chat inference. Points are not model tokens.
en.description: Use your Z.ai key for web search. Changes apply to the next search.
en.endpointHint: Choose the service that issued your key, then Save. The endpoint is not chosen from your language or location.
en.invalid: Check the endpoint, credential reference, or selected value.
en.keyFailed: The key was not saved. Check credential storage access and retry.
en.keyHint: Leave blank to keep the current key. Replacing this shared key also affects chat.
en.literalKey: A literal apiKey in your configuration overrides the managed key. Remove that literal to manage the key here.
en.partialSave: Search settings were saved, but the key was not saved. Re-enter the key and save again.
en.refHint: Default: ZAI_API_KEY. Save a changed reference before entering its key.
en.resetDone: Search overrides cleared. Your shared key was kept.
en.settingsFailed: Search settings were not saved. Review the current values and retry.
en.stale: Settings changed while you were editing. Discard edits and try again.
en.storage: The key is stored by DSH credentials. Other fields use DSH settings. Reset restores inherited search settings and keeps your shared key.
en.title: Web Search (Z.ai)
en.unavailable: Settings are loading, unavailable, or read-only in this connection.
